reviewer.independence_limit: This remains an OpenAI-family review and supplies no independent-family quorum.

cross_examined_review.version_limit: Terra reviewed the pre-repair engineering files, so its substantive observations are useful but its hashes and owner assessment do not validate the repaired bytes.

prior_findings.assessment: The files remain truthful that executable TLA+, model checking, runtime tests, TUF/in-toto implementation, simulation and full STPA are pending. This is acceptable for a draft design and still blocks any completion, qualification or deployment claim.

Each profile now identifies itself as a FunctionContract requirement profile, declares null contract ID/version and UNRESOLVED_REQUIRED_BEFORE_EXECUTABLE_ADMISSION, and lists authority/consent, result algebra, invalidators, resources/termination, dependencies and provenance obligations. It no longer masquerades as a machine-resolvable contract. All 20 bindings remain intentionally unresolved and therefore cannot support executable admission.

The repaired files separate one primary architecture owner from affected artifacts and dependencies. All 20 owner bindings resolve to exact predecessor path, heading, line, file hash and line hash; the recheck found zero mismatches.

EH-18 replaces the ambiguous [0,10] handoff-entry field with takeover_recoverable_region(D,e), requires uncertainty-interval containment, labels threshold arithmetic unvalidated, and enumerates sampling, sensor, delay, actuator, command-order and discretization proof obligations. Execution and qualification remain pending.

The diff checker now returns DIFF_MATCH_ONLY, states that admission is not checked, and always sets admitted_diff_verified and canonical_promotion_authorized false. Its regression test demonstrates that even a self-declared ADMITTED manifest cannot manufacture approval.

The inventory now distinguishes contiguous section-boundary coverage from semantic closure through coverage_scope and section_boundary_coverage_complete. The separate closure receipt remains correctly INCONCLUSIVE with complete_semantic_reference_closure=false, 55 inherited unresolved anchors, zero new unresolved anchors and zero qualified units.

The engineering profiles now define T-EH-01 through T-EH-20, provide per-profile owner/anchor maps, and explicitly mark Annexure/User/System/Theories copies as nonnormative projections. Candidate generation distributes owner-grouped pending clauses by role. Full semantic closure and qualified review still remain release gates.
The change remains a large safety/authority/execution design package. Required protected/MAJOR release evidence and independent-family review are not supplied by these two OpenAI-family reviews.

agreements_with_terra: All 38 work items have substantive, uniquely numbered design coverage.
The documents preserve truthful design-versus-execution boundaries.
Revocation, uncertain completion and conjunctive supply-chain verification are materially well specified.
The tank arithmetic is internally consistent as a proposed bound and is not execution evidence.
qualification_of_terra: Terra's NO_BLOCKING_DESIGN_COVERAGE_FINDING applies to the earlier engineering hashes and did not perform exhaustive owner compatibility analysis.
Both reviews are OpenAI-family reviews and cannot be counted as independent-family quorum.
The repaired owner and EH-18 language resolves concerns Terra did not flag, but only for draft-design clarity.

approval.rationale: The concrete drafting, ownership-labeling, physical-boundary, diff-scope and inventory-labeling defects found in the blind review are repaired. Open machine bindings, unexecuted work, inconclusive semantic closure, zero qualified review units and missing independent-family release evidence continue to block any stronger conclusion.
